# R Markdown

# read in the files (Date, Time (HH:MM:SS), Time (s), DO) and setwd and directory for files 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(drc)
library(SciViews)
library(gridExtra)

# set working directory
setwd(".../location")

test<-read.csv("...file.csv",header=T)
  colnames(test)

# adjust time_seconds in file to start at 0
test<- test %>% mutate(time_seconds = Time..s. - min(Time..s.))
max(test$time_seconds)/60

# Set directory & state file name pattern
directory<-".../location"
file_pattern <- "_HRC"

# List all files in the directory that match the pattern
files <- list.files(pattern = file_pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  view(files)
```

# Calculate VO2 for each coral sample & plot HRC
```{r}
# ---- 1. Read in specific HRC file and define constants ----
test <- read.csv("...file_HRC.csv", header = TRUE)
  str(test)

# Define constants for this specific coral sample (control, vol, SA)
O2_blank <- 0.05          # Water blank in mg/L 
vessel_volume <- 0.45     # Vessel volume after displacement in L 
surface_area <- 85.25     # Coral surface area in cm² 

# ---- 2. Preprocess: time and O2 conversion (convert % to mg O2/L) ----
test <- test %>%
  mutate(
    time_seconds = Time..s. - min(Time..s.),
    O2 = (DO / 100) * 6.53  # (use O2 conversion table, i.e., 100% DO ≃ 6.53mg/L @ 27°C, 35 ppt)
  )

test$time_minutes <- test$time_seconds / 60  # Optional readability

# ---- 3. Subset data at 5-minute intervals ----
interval <- 300  # i.e., 5 mins in seconds
max_time <- max(test$time_seconds)

target_intervals <- seq(0, max_time, by = interval)

hrc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(target_intervals, function(target) {
  test[which.min(abs(test$time_seconds - target)), ]
}))

# ---- 4. Calculate blank-corrected and surface-area/vol-normalized VO2 ----
hrc2 <- hrc %>%
  mutate(O2_corrected = O2 - O2_blank,
    VO2 = c(NA,-diff(O2_corrected) / diff(time_seconds / 60) * 60 * vessel_volume / surface_area))

# ---- 5. Filter to valid range ----
hrc2 <- filter(hrc2, DO <= 100, DO > 0.5)

# Export "hrc2" to .xlsx 
write.xlsx(hrc2, "...file_HRC.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)

# ---- 6. Plot VO2 vs DO ----
ggplot(hrc2, aes(x = DO, y = VO2)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Remove a specific row with outlier, if needed
```{r}
# Remove a specific row (e.g., to remove row 5, "-5")
hrc2 <- hrc2[-1, ]
```

# Fit Michaelis-Menten model to HRC, calculate regulation curve, and extract Pcmax & Tpos
```{r}
MichaelisModel <- drm(VO2~DO, data = hrc2, fct = MM.2())
MMLine <- data.frame(DO = seq(0, max(hrc2$DO), length.out = 100)) 
MMLine$VO2 <- predict(MichaelisModel, newdata = MMLine)

# estimates of coefficients are pulled directly from model
A=MichaelisModel$coefficients[[1]] 
H=MichaelisModel$coefficients[[2]]

results <- data.frame(PO2 = numeric(0), Rho = numeric(0))

# Calculate values for pO2 from 1 to 100 and save to results df
for (DO in seq(0,max(hrc2$DO),length.out=200)) {
  Rho <- A * (DO / (H + DO)^2)
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(DO = DO, Rho = Rho))
}

# Summary of results
print(results)
Tpos=A*((H/(H+100))+ln(H+100)-1-ln(H))
Tpos

Pcmax=results$DO[which.max(results$Rho)]
Pcmax

ggplot(hrc2,aes(x=DO,y=VO2))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(data=MMLine)
ggsave("...file_HRC.png", width=10, height=7)
```
